question: Does the Go suite pass at the pinned WeftFS-Go revision, including the R14d Azure MW2 test, so R14d can stay on staging?

commands.whole_suite: cargo build --release --features fuse --bin weftfs && cd WeftFS-Go && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./... && go vet ./... && WEFTFS_RUST_BIN=/work/.docker-cache/target-rust/release/weftfs go test -race ./... -count=1

go_court_limitation.cause: 17 fusefs tests call mount(8), which execs /bin/fusermount; the minimal go court does not install it ("stat /bin/fusermount: no such file or directory"). The store package itself passed (ok 210.396s). This is an environment limit of that court, not a test failure, and the supported whole-suite court is the fuse court.

conclusion: R14d is verified at WeftFS-Go 1fa3d32 in the fuse court: the whole Go suite passes under -race with 0 failures, go vet is clean, the CGO-disabled build is clean, and TestAzureOptimisticTwoDisjointCommitters passes. R14d stays on staging; no r14d/azure-mw2 branch is required.
not_claimed: No live Azure account was used; the Azure tests run against the in-process Azure double and the Azurite court, not Azure Blob Storage.
One host, one court; no fleet, cloud, or power-loss claim.
